title: EXCLUSIVE: ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent place over $35 billion worth of Nvidia chip orders
script:
ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent just placed over thirty-five billion dollars in Nvidia chip orders.
These massive orders target specialized hardware to maintain their internal AI inference workloads.
This spending surge highlights their urgent race to build competitive domestic AI models.
The move comes as US export controls tighten around advanced data center silicon access.
These firms previously relied on now-restricted hardware to power their large-scale training clusters.
Can these companies sustain their AI development pace without unrestricted access to top-tier chips?
